blurb: Guests can rent beach equipment like umbrellas, chairs, shade canopies, and body boards with delivery, setup, and pickup at Buckroe Beach. They can take regular or private eFoil lessons with clear instruction to build confidence and experience riding above the water. Kayak and paddleboard rentals are available with life vests and safety gear to explore the calm waters and local wildlife of Chesapeake Bay.
extraNote: We choose the best lesson location each day based on weather, wind, water conditions, visibility, and safety. · Weather and Safety Safety comes first. · Green Wave Watersports may delay, relocate, reschedule, or cancel lessons due to unsafe weather, wind, water conditions, storms, lightning, poor visibility, or any other safety concern. · If Green Wave Watersports cancels your lesson due to unsafe weather or water conditions, you may reschedule or receive a full refund. · This fee covers nonrefundable credit card processing and administrative costs. · Cancel at least 48 hours before your lesson to receive a refund, less the 6% cancellation fee. · Cancellations made less than 24 hours before

quotes.text: We had an amazing time kayaking, we even got to see dolphins up close and personal. After that we rented some amazing beach equipment and spent the rest of the day chilling on the beach. Wonderful teams who made sure we had a fabulous time while visiting our daughter and friend who are in the Navy.
I had an amazing experience! The staff was super friendly and very informative! I will definitely be coming back and sending friends and family their way!
Had the best time at Buckroe Beach! The guys at Green Wave Watersports had the sunscreen and the tent we needed. They are so very nice and accommodating.
